title.zh: 20 件專案、9,000 萬元的組合管理

result.zh: 兩件 4,000 萬元案從開案跟到兩年交付結束。
result.en: Two NT$40M programs held from kickoff through a two-year delivery cycle.

s.zh: 同時在跑 20 件以上的案子——智慧建築、智慧工廠、硬體採購、公部門物聯網——每案 5 到 20 家下包商，外加公家審查單位。

title.zh: 機電標案議價整併，省下 15%

result.zh: 較議價前基準降低 600 萬元。

s.zh: 4,000 萬元的機電標案由 20 家以上下包商分散報價，範圍互相重疊。
s.en: A NT$40M MEP package quoted by 20+ subcontractors, fragmented and overlapping.

a.zh: 用成本與範圍的結構化評分框架逐一審查每份報價，再議價整併成單一執行契約。
a.en: Scored every proposal against a structured cost-and-scope framework, then negotiated consolidation into a single execution contract.

r.zh: 降低 600 萬元（15%），而且範圍責任歸屬變清楚。
r.en: NT$6M (15%) saved, with scope ownership finally unambiguous.

kicker.zh: 採購與議價 · 集星資通

v.zh: 一件智慧建築案裡的機電工程包，金額 4,000 萬元，是整個案子最大的一包。發包由我負責。
v.en: The MEP package inside a smart-building project — NT$40M, the largest single package in the job. Sourcing was mine to run.

v.zh: 這一包是開工三個月之後換廠商，才找上我們。時程從接手那天就是趕的：送審、備料、人員報備這些前期行政作業全部來不及照正常節奏走，等於後面要用雙倍人力補做前面沒做完的事。議價不是在從容的狀態下談的，是一邊趕工一邊談。
v.en: We were brought in three months after construction had started, replacing the previous vendor. The schedule was tight from day one: submissions, material lead times and personnel registration could not follow their normal rhythm, so later stages had to be double-staffed to catch up. The negotiation happened under that pressure, not in calm conditions.

v.zh: 20 家以上的下包各報各的，報價範圍互相重疊也互相漏接。同一項工作有三家報、另一項沒人報，總價看起來合理，但責任邊界是破的——真的照這樣發包，施工時每個介面都會吵。
v.en: 20+ subcontractors each quoted their own scope. The scopes overlapped in places and left gaps in others: three bids for the same work, none for the next item. The total looked reasonable, but the responsibility boundaries were broken — every interface would become a dispute on site.

v.zh: 不比總價，先把每一份報價拆回「成本 × 範圍」兩個軸。做一張結構化評分表：每個工項逐一對照，誰有報、報多少、含不含輔料與測試、介面由誰負責。拆完之後才看得出來，價差大部分不是單價差異，是範圍認定不同。
v.en: Instead of comparing totals, I decomposed every quote onto two axes: cost and scope. A structured scoring sheet listed each work item against every bid — who quoted it, at what price, whether consumables and testing were included, who owned the interface. Once decomposed, it was clear that most of the spread came from differing scope assumptions, not unit prices.

v.zh: 用那張表當議價的共同語言：把重疊的部分攤開讓廠商知道我清楚誰在報什麼，再把範圍重新切乾淨，整併成單一份執行契約。
v.en: The sheet became the shared language for negotiation: overlaps were put on the table so vendors knew I could see exactly what each had quoted; scope was then re-cut cleanly and consolidated into one execution contract.

v.zh: 較議價前基準降低 600 萬元（15%），而且範圍責任歸屬在簽約時就清楚，不留到施工期吵。
v.en: NT$6M (15%) below the pre-negotiation baseline — and scope ownership was unambiguous at signing, not argued during construction.

title.zh: 卡四個月的市府送審，一個月核准
title.en: A stalled government submission cleared in one month

result.zh: 另撰寫標案建議書，取得台電與桃園市政府標案。
result.en: Also authored the RFP responses that won Taipower and Taoyuan City Government awards.

s.zh: 一份桃園市政府的送審文件已經改了四個月還沒通過。
s.en: A Taoyuan City Government submission had been in revision for four months without approval.

a.zh: 中途接手，重建規範比較文件，並重新打通與審查委員的溝通管道。
a.en: Took it over mid-flight, rebuilt the specification-comparison package and reopened the line to the reviewing committee.

kicker.zh: 公部門送審 · 集星資通

stats.zh: 件標案：台電、桃園市政府

v.zh: 桃園市政府的一份材料設備送審文件，在我接手前已經來回修改四個月。
v.en: A Taoyuan City Government material-and-equipment submission that had been going back and forth for four months before I took it over.

v.zh: 每退一次就改一次，改完再送、再退。沒有人去問「到底是哪一條不過」。
v.en: Each rejection produced an edit, another submission, another rejection. Nobody had asked which specific clause was failing.

v.zh: 把退件意見逐條對回規範條文，發現問題不在規格本身，而在比較表的呈現方式——審查委員沒辦法一眼對上規範與型錄。那是文件結構的問題，不是產品的問題。
v.en: Mapping every comment back to its spec clause showed the issue was not the specification but the comparison table: the reviewer could not line up the spec against the catalogue at a glance. A document-structure problem, not a product problem.

v.zh: 重建規範比較文件，讓每一條規範、投標型錄、送審型號三欄並排對齊；同時重新打通與審查單位的溝通，當面確認理解一致再送。
v.en: Rebuilt the comparison package so spec clause, tendered catalogue and submitted model sat in three aligned columns; reopened the line to the reviewing committee to confirm understanding before resubmitting.

v.zh: 一個月內核准。後續也由我撰寫標案建議書，取得台電與桃園市政府的標案。
v.en: Cleared in one month. I went on to author the RFP responses that won Taipower and Taoyuan City Government awards.

title.zh: 公司第一套跨專案金流與排程管控
title.en: The company's first portfolio-wide control layer

result.zh: 內部期限固定提前契約里程碑一週。
result.en: Internal deadlines held one week ahead of contractual milestones.

s.zh: 原本沒有跨案的金流與排程視圖，進度只存在於每週的口頭會議裡。
s.en: No shared view of project cash or schedule — status lived in a weekly verbal meeting.

a.zh: 建置互動式金流模型與涵蓋全部 20+ 專案的甘特主排程。
a.en: Built an interactive cash-flow model and a Gantt master schedule covering all 20+ active projects.

r.en: Management gained a single view of committed vs. billed vs. collected cash; teams self-align on dependencies instead of waiting for the meeting.

kicker.zh: 金流與管控 · 集星資通

big.zh: 內部期限對契約里程碑

stats.zh: 個專案在同一張排程上
種金流狀態：已發包／已計價／已收款
套，公司第一個跨案管控層

v.zh: 公司同時在跑 20 件以上的案子，每件都有自己的計價期程與下包付款條件。
v.en: 20+ concurrent projects, each with its own billing cycle and subcontractor payment terms.

v.zh: 沒有跨案的金流與排程視圖。進度只存在於每週的口頭會議，收款落後或相依卡住，往往等到開會才知道。
v.en: No portfolio-wide view of cash or schedule. Status lived in a weekly verbal meeting, so late collections and blocked dependencies surfaced only at that meeting.

v.zh: 先把「錢的狀態」拆成三段：已發包、已計價、已收款。延遲會卡在哪一段，決定要找的人完全不同——卡在計價是我們自己的事，卡在收款是業主的事，卡在發包是採購的事。把三段分開記，問題才有歸屬。
v.en: I split cash into three states: committed, billed, collected. Where a delay sits determines who can unblock it — billing is ours, collection is the client's, commitment is sourcing's. Separating the three gave every delay an owner.

v.zh: 建互動式金流模型加上涵蓋全部專案的甘特主排程，兩者用同一組專案編號串起來，管理層與各專案看的是同一份。
v.en: An interactive cash-flow model plus a Gantt master schedule covering every active project, joined on one project key so management and project teams read the same source.

v.zh: 管理層第一次有單一視圖；團隊自己對照相依關係，不用等每週會議。內部期限固定壓在契約里程碑前一週。
v.en: Management gained a single view; teams self-align on dependencies instead of waiting for the meeting. Internal deadlines now sit a week ahead of contractual milestones.

v.zh: 同一套邏輯後來被我拿去做單一案子的請款預估與現金流分析——那份有完整的圖表與結論，已去識別化之後放在作品集裡。
v.en: The same logic later became a full billing-forecast and cash-flow analysis for a single project — charted end to end, de-identified and published in the portfolio.

title.zh: 從 0 建到 10+ 投資人 pipeline
title.en: Built a 10+ investor pipeline from zero

result.zh: 成為所有募資動作的單一事實來源。
result.en: A single source of truth for all fundraising.

s.zh: 0 個投資人會議、沒有 GTM、沒有任何對外材料。
s.en: Zero investor meetings, no GTM, no materials.

a.zh: 把 GTM 拆成三個工作軌道；撰寫 15 頁白皮書與 Pitch Deck（Sharpe、最大回撤、相對基準的 alpha），對象是 LP。
a.en: Decomposed GTM into three workstreams; authored a 15-page white paper and pitch deck (Sharpe, max drawdown, alpha vs. benchmark) for LP audiences.

r.zh: 從零建立 10+ 投資人 pipeline。

v.zh: 量化交易新創，技術做得出來，但對外一份材料都沒有，投資人會議是 0。
v.en: A quant trading startup with working technology, zero outbound materials and zero investor meetings.

v.zh: 團隊講得出 Sharpe 跟回撤，但 LP 聽不懂；LP 想問的是「這跟我現在持有的部位比起來如何」。兩邊用的不是同一種語言。
v.en: The team could talk Sharpe and drawdown; LPs could not. LPs wanted to know how it compared with what they already held. The two sides were not speaking the same language.

v.zh: 先分清楚讀者層級：C-level 要三分鐘看完結論、投資經理要標準化的財務指標、技術盡職調查要模型細節。同一份東西寫三個版本會立刻不同步，所以改成一份文件分三層。
v.en: Separate the readers: C-suite needs a three-minute conclusion, investment managers need standardised financial metrics, technical DD needs model detail. Three separate versions would drift apart immediately, so one document in three tiers.

v.zh: 15 頁白皮書加 Pitch Deck，把量化模型翻譯成 LP 讀得懂的財務敘事；GTM 拆成三條軌道分頭推進；投資人 CRM 記 3 個階段、5 類異議、轉換機率。
v.en: A 15-page white paper and pitch deck translating the quant models into LP-readable financial narrative; GTM split into three parallel workstreams; an investor CRM tracking three stages, five objection categories and conversion probability.

v.zh: 從零建立 10+ 投資人 pipeline，一份材料服務所有層級，募資動作有單一事實來源。
v.en: A 10+ investor pipeline from zero, one document serving every reader level, and a single source of truth for fundraising.

title.zh: 三層白皮書，一份文件服務所有層級

result.zh: 不需要為不同層級的投資人各做一個版本。
result.en: Eliminated the need for three separate versions.

s.zh: 投資人從 C-level 到技術盡職調查都要看，但關心的東西完全不同。
s.en: Investors from C-suite to quant DD all needed the same story at different depths.

a.zh: 拆成三層：高階摘要 → 標準化財務指標 → 量化盡職調查附錄。
a.en: Three tiers: C-suite exec summary → standardized financial metrics → quant DD appendix.

r.zh: 單一份材料服務每一種投資人。
r.en: One document served every investor level.

result.zh: 10+ 潛在投資人依資料排優先順序，不靠印象。

s.zh: 募資進度散在對話與記憶裡，沒辦法判斷先追誰。
s.en: Fundraising status lived in conversations and memory.

a.zh: 設計 3 個 pipeline 階段、5 類異議分類、轉換機率分數。
a.en: Three pipeline stages, five objection categories, conversion probability scores.

r.zh: 排序有依據，異議也能回頭統計。
r.en: Prioritisation became repeatable, and objections became countable.

title.zh: 跨六個司法管轄區的設點決策摘要

result.zh: 成為董事會選址與成本結構決策的主要依據。

a.zh: 四層拆解加上 8 個差異標記，三週內收斂成 12 頁。
a.en: Four-layer decomposition plus eight variance flags, condensed into 12 pages in three weeks.

r.en: A 12-page brief went straight to the board.

title.zh: 非結構化資料的 Python pipeline

r.zh: 同樣的分析下一案可以直接重跑。
r.en: The same analysis became repeatable on the next deal.

title.zh: 壽星日：台灣生日優惠整理站

result.zh: 線上營運中，已累積 11,205 次收藏、4,784 次使用回報。
result.en: Live, with 11,205 saves and 4,784 usage reports.

s.zh: 生日優惠散在各品牌的公告與部落格懶人包裡，而且常常過期。
s.en: Birthday offers are scattered across brand announcements and blog round-ups, and go stale fast.

a.zh: 一個人做完企劃、前後端、資料整理與分析，154 個版本、92 支回歸測試。
a.en: Solo: product, front and back end, data curation and analysis — 154 versions, 92 regression tests.

r.zh: 581 筆優惠在線，兌換成功率 98%。

kicker.zh: 自有產品 · 小數據所

images.zh: 優惠清單：581 筆、依省最多排序、每張卡片帶使用回報與成功率
images.en: The offer list: 581 live offers, sorted by value, each card carrying usage reports and success rate

v.zh: 生日優惠散在各品牌公告、部落格懶人包跟社群貼文裡，而且過期得很快。要用的那一天才去找，通常來不及。
v.en: Birthday offers are scattered across brand announcements, blog round-ups and social posts, and they go stale fast. Searching on the day itself is usually too late.

v.zh: 一年只會用一次的人。這決定了整個產品：留存不能看次日留存，要看「隔年還會不會回來」；提醒要提前，因為一半的優惠當天辦來不及。
v.en: People who use it once a year. That shapes everything: retention is not day-1 but next-year, and reminders must be early, because half the offers cannot be claimed same-day.

v.zh: 581 筆優惠、22 個縣市、4,700 家對得上的門市；154 個版本、92 支回歸測試；企劃、前後端、資料整理與分析都一個人做。
v.en: 581 offers, 22 counties, 4,700 matched stores; 154 releases, 92 regression tests; product, front and back end, data and analysis all solo.

v.zh: 把資料丟進 SQLite 問十一個問題：哪一類最大方、多少優惠其實當天辦來不及、住不同縣市差多少、資料本身有多可信。供給面算完才發現需求跟供給是錯開的——零售美妝只佔 3.3% 的優惠數，卻吃掉 9.3% 的收藏。
v.en: Eleven questions in SQL: which category is most generous, how many offers cannot be claimed same-day, how much location matters, how trustworthy the data is. The supply-demand gap only showed up once both sides were measured: cosmetics is 3.3% of supply but 9.3% of saves.

v.zh: 過期自動下架（靠人記得一定會漏）、來源分級顯示在卡片上、提前提醒、下一批優先談美妝與飲料。都是從上面那些數字推出來的。
v.en: Auto-expiry by valid_until, source tier shown on each card, early reminders, and cosmetics and drinks first in the next sourcing round. Each one follows from a number above.

v.zh: 11,205 次收藏、4,784 次回報、98% 兌換成功率。全部跑在免費方案上，一次流量超額之後把每日用量砍掉 25%。
v.en: 11,205 saves, 4,784 usage reports, 98% redemption success, all on free tiers, with daily usage cut 25% after one quota overrun.

result.zh: 兩支都已在 Google Play 上架。

s.zh: 看團的紀錄散在票根跟限動裡；而通訊軟體上花掉的注意力沒有人在算。
s.en: Gig history lives in ticket stubs; attention spent in chat apps goes uncounted.

a.zh: Bandary：Kotlin + Compose，59,526 行。RelateStats：刻意不加網路權限，資料不離開手機。
a.en: Bandary: Kotlin + Compose, 59,526 lines. RelateStats: deliberately no INTERNET permission — data never leaves the phone.

r.zh: RelateStats 的取捨是「收不到任何遙測」，所以衡量方式整套要換，這本身就是一個產品決策案例。
r.en: RelateStats trades away all telemetry, so the whole measurement approach had to change — a product decision case in itself.

title.zh: 21,209 家店的座標，自動長出商圈

result.zh: 對上人工圈的商圈 79.7%，並補出台中、台南等手工沒做到的縣市。
result.en: 79.7% match against 148 hand-drawn districts, and filled in the counties the manual list never reached.

s.zh: 手工圈的 148 個商圈只覆蓋雙北與幾個大城市。
s.en: The 148 hand-drawn districts only covered Taipei and a few cities.

a.zh: DBSCAN + haversine 分群，掃 12 組參數，用人工商圈當對照組驗收。
a.en: DBSCAN with haversine distance, 12 parameter sets, validated against the manual districts.

r.zh: 對不上的 30 個全是郊區購物中心——那是方法的邊界，不是模型不好。
r.en: The 30 misses are all suburban malls — the method's boundary, not a model failure.

kicker.zh: 資料分析 · 小數據所

big.zh: 自動分群對上人工圈的商圈

v.zh: 優惠綁在店家上，但使用者問的是「我附近有什麼」。手工圈的 148 個商圈只覆蓋雙北跟幾個大城市，其他縣市等於沒有。
v.en: Offers attach to stores, but users ask what is near them. The 148 hand-drawn districts only covered Taipei and a few cities; everywhere else had none.

v.zh: 先定義什麼叫商圈：密度夠、而且品牌夠雜。只看密度會把同一條街的五家手搖當成商圈，那是展店策略不是商圈，所以加一條「至少三個不同品牌」。參數掃 12 組，用人工圈的 148 個當對照組驗收，而不是用 silhouette 自我感覺良好。
v.en: First define a district: dense enough, and mixed enough. Density alone would call five branches of one chain a district, which is an expansion strategy, not a district, so clusters need at least three distinct brands. Twelve parameter sets, validated against the 148 manual districts rather than against silhouette alone.

v.zh: 半徑放大反而對不上：150 公尺拉到 300 公尺，收進的店從 50% 升到 78%，但對上人工的比例從 79.7% 掉到 33.8%——街區被黏成一塊，重心飄走了。
v.en: A bigger radius matched worse: from 150m to 300m, store coverage rose from 50% to 78% but the match rate fell from 79.7% to 33.8%, because neighbouring blocks merged and the centroid drifted.

v.zh: 對不上的 30 個全是郊區大型購物中心。一棟樓裡五十家店，在地圖上只是一個點，密度法本來就抓不到。結論是商圈有兩種，不是模型不夠好。
v.en: All 30 misses are suburban malls: fifty shops in one building is a single point on the map. There are two kinds of district, not one weak model.

v.zh: 台中人工 19 個、自動 203 個；台南 6 對 82。自動化補的正是手工做不動的地方。
v.en: Taichung: 19 manual versus 203 automatic; Tainan 6 versus 82. Automation filled exactly the gap manual work could not reach.

title.zh: 投稿欄位自動預填（文字分類）
title.en: A text classifier for submission fields

result.zh: 六成投稿可以自動填，其中 92.4% 正確。
result.en: 64% of submissions auto-filled, 92.4% of them correct.

s.zh: 使用者投稿進來是一段自由文字，三個欄位要人一筆一筆判斷。
s.en: User submissions arrive as free text; three coded fields were judged by hand.

a.zh: 581 筆標註資料、字元 n-gram TF-IDF、五折交叉驗證，並用信心門檻換覆蓋率。
a.en: 581 labelled rows, char n-gram TF-IDF, 5-fold CV, and a confidence threshold traded for coverage.

r.zh: 另外兩個欄位做不起來，消融實驗證明原因是資料洩漏與分類法，不是模型。
r.en: Two other fields failed; ablations showed the cause was leakage and taxonomy, not the model.

title.zh: 機電工程請款預估與現金流
title.en: A billing forecast and cash-flow model

result.zh: 手上看似有 528 萬，還原預收與保留款後實質是 −51 萬。
result.en: A NT$5.28M cash balance that, adjusted for deposit and retention, is actually −NT$509K.

s.zh: 一個 4,242 萬元的機電工程案，四期請款、23 家下包、到 2028 年的現金流。
s.en: A NT$42.4M MEP contract: four billing periods, 23 subcontractors, cash flow out to 2028.

a.zh: 把預收訂金、預付款、雙邊保留款全部還原，逐期對照計價與實際入帳。
a.en: Unwound the deposit, advances and retention held on both sides, period by period.

r.zh: 每收 100 元的估驗要付出去 86 元——施工期墊錢不是虧損，是在還簽約時收的訂金。順帶抓出四個待確認項目。
r.en: Per NT$100 billed, NT$86 goes out — the shortfall is the deposit being repaid, not a loss. Four open items surfaced along the way.

links.zh: 看那份分析（已去識別化）

body.zh: 專案最昂貴的錯誤，是精準地做出了錯的東西。我在任何人動工前，先把範圍白紙黑字定下來。
body.en: The most expensive project mistake is building precisely the wrong thing. I lock scope in writing before anyone starts work.

body.zh: 「為什麼會延？」→ 範圍 vs. 廠商 vs. 送審 vs. 金流。拆開來看才找得到真正的卡點，而不是追著症狀跑。
body.en: "Why is this late?" → scope vs. vendor vs. approval vs. cash. Separating the layers finds the real blocker instead of chasing symptoms.

approach.zh: 每份回報都要一個決定
approach.en: Every report asks for a call

body.zh: 不會改變任何決策的進度回報只是雜訊。我發出的每份報告都以「我需要你做什麼決定、什麼時候之前」作結。
body.en: A status update that changes no decision is noise. Every report I send ends with: here is the call I need from you, and by when.
